records.coverage: India - myAadhaar online services, Aadhaar updates and support
records.description: Use myAadhaar for the online Aadhaar services offered there. The official Aadhaar app also supports mobile-number and address updates subject to its authentication conditions; biometric updates require an authorised centre.
steps: Choose the relevant service on myAadhaar; review the official update and accepted-document guidance for the detail being changed.
For an app mobile-number update, follow the official Aadhaar app instructions for OTP checks and Face Authentication.
Use an authorised enrolment or update centre for biometric changes, a first mobile-number registration, or when the old registered mobile number is unavailable.
Review the entered details, pay only the applicable published charge, and keep the acknowledgement or request number for tracking.
records.fees: Standalone demographic update: INR 75, subject to published exemptions. A biometric update is INR 125 unless an applicable age-based exemption applies. Document update costs INR 75 at a centre and is free through myAadhaar until 14 June 2027. UIDAI lists an Aadhaar-app email-update fee waiver through 31 December 2026; check the current fee notice for other exemptions.
records.onlineOption: myAadhaar web portal; official Aadhaar app for the services and authentication modes it supports.
records.offlineOption: Authorised Aadhaar enrolment/update centre; use the official Bhuvan locator.
records.escalation: Raise or track an Aadhaar grievance through the UIDAI grievance channels, helpline or verified support email.
conditions: The Aadhaar app is separate from the myAadhaar website. App mobile-number updates require OTP verification and Face Authentication; the required OTPs depend on the number used to register the app.
If there is no access to the old registered mobile number, or no mobile number has been registered before, visit an authorised centre.
A biometric lock/unlock service does not change the stored photograph, fingerprints or iris data. Updating those biometrics requires a centre.
Document update verifies documents supporting existing details; it is a different service from correcting demographic details. Check the fee notice and the selected service before paying.

records.coverage: India - Aadhaar enrolment and update centres shown by the official locator
records.description: Locate an Aadhaar enrolment or update centre. This map is a directory, not an online update submission form.
steps: Search the official locator by location or PIN code.
Check the centre details before visiting for the required enrolment or update service.

contactPhone.purpose: UIDAI Aadhaar support and centre queries

records.coverage: India - electoral registration and EPIC services through the ECI portal
records.description: Use Form 6 for new registration and Form 8 for shifting residence, correcting an existing entry or replacing an EPIC. The portal also provides application tracking.
steps: Use Form 6 for first-time electoral registration or Form 8 for shifting residence, correcting an existing entry or replacing an EPIC.
Complete the chosen form and follow its current supporting-document instructions.
Retain the acknowledgement number and track the application on the official voter portal.
For an electoral service query or grievance, use the official NGSP route, voter helpline or ECI complaint email.
records.onlineOption: ECI Voters Service Portal; National Grievance Service Portal for electoral grievances.
records.offlineOption: The relevant Electoral Registration Officer or Booth Level Officer, using the applicable ECI form.
records.escalation: Register and track election-related grievances through ECI NGSP: https://voters.eci.gov.in/home/ngsp/ .
conditions: Form 6 is for a new electoral-roll application. An elector shifting an existing registration uses Form 8.
The ECI complaint email and helpline support electoral queries and grievances; submitting a query does not replace the applicable registration form.
Application approval and verification are handled by the electoral authorities. No universal approval or EPIC-delivery deadline is stated here.

contactPhone.purpose: ECI voter helpline and general enquiries

records.department: Department of Food and Public Distribution / State and UT Food Departments
records.coverage: India - directory of State and UT food and public distribution portals
records.description: Find the responsible food department for ration-card applications and changes. NFSA identifies State and UT administrations as responsible for beneficiary identification and issuing AAY and PHH ration cards.
records.responsibility: Beneficiary identification and issuance of NFSA ration cards are handled by the respective State Government or UT Administration.
conditions: This directory does not submit an application or decide NFSA eligibility. Ask the relevant State or UT food department about family inclusion, card splitting and eligibility disputes.

records.coverage: India - official district court directory; the competent court must be confirmed for the case
records.description: For a court-issued succession certificate, use the official district court directory to locate a court website and seek filing guidance from its registry. This court process is separate from an administrative legal-heir certificate.
steps: Open the relevant district court website from the official directory.
Contact its registry for the applicable succession-certificate procedure and confirmation of the competent court.
conditions: This directory does not submit a case or establish which court has jurisdiction.
No online filing availability, eligibility, document list, fee or processing time is confirmed by this directory record.

records.department: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways / State Transport Departments
records.coverage: Participating States and UTs listed on Sarathi - driving and learner licences
records.description: Sarathi provides driving-licence and learner-licence services. Choose the relevant state on the official portal to see the services available there.
steps: Open Sarathi and select the state from which the licence service is required.
Choose the learner-licence or driving-licence service and follow the state-specific instructions shown.
Keep the application number and complete any document, payment, appointment or test step required for that service.

contactEmail.purpose: Sarathi technical support for learner and driving licence services

conditions: Online availability and any appointment, test, document or fee requirements depend on the selected state and licence service.
The listed email and phone are technical support contacts. The responsible State Transport Department or RTO decides the application.

contactPhone.purpose: Parivahan technical helpdesk for licence-service portal issues

records.department: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways / State Transport Departments
records.coverage: Participating registering authorities - vehicle registration and RC services
records.description: Vahan offers vehicle services, including RC-related applications and hypothecation services where enabled by the registering authority.
steps: Open Vahan and select the applicable state or registering authority for the vehicle.
Choose the available RC, ownership, address or hypothecation service that matches the request.
Follow the service instructions and keep the application and payment references; complete an RTO visit if required.

contactEmail.purpose: Vahan technical support for vehicle registration and related portal services

conditions: Select the authority where the vehicle is registered and check the available service.
Authentication modes, published charges, supporting documents and any RTO visit depend on the state and service.
The listed email and phone handle technical problems; the registering authority decides the application. mParivahan app support uses a different email.

contactPhone.purpose: Parivahan technical helpdesk for vehicle-service portal issues

records.department: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways / National Informatics Centre
records.coverage: India - NextGen mParivahan app; service availability depends on the state and service
records.description: Official information about the NextGen mParivahan mobile app and the transport services it supports. App technical-support queries have a separate email from Sarathi and Vahan web-service queries.
steps: Check the official app information and the services available for the relevant state.
Use the app support contact for an app-specific technical problem.

contactPhone.purpose: Parivahan technical helpdesk for mParivahan app issues

conditions: For driving-licence web applications use Sarathi; for vehicle/RC web applications use Vahan. The app helpdesk does not decide RTO applications.

records.department: Department of Land Resources / State and UT Revenue Departments
records.coverage: India - directory of State and UT Record of Rights portals
records.description: Find the official state land-record portal for Record of Rights services. The directory includes Tamil Nadu land records and other state systems.
records.responsibility: Land records are maintained by State and UT Revenue Departments.
conditions: This is a directory, not a national application form. It does not itself issue an Encumbrance Certificate or municipal Khata.

records.department: Greater Bengaluru Authority / relevant Bengaluru City Corporation
records.coverage: Bengaluru - applicable city corporation property records and Khata services
records.description: The authority website links e-Aasthi, Khata services and an e-Khata helpdesk. Use its official services list to find the applicable property-record route.
conditions: This option covers the relevant Bengaluru city corporation only. It is not a Karnataka-wide Record of Rights or EC portal.

records.coverage: Delhi - building proposals within MCD responsibility
records.description: MCD provides an Online Building Plan Approval System for building permits and occupancy-cum-completion certificates, with application tracking and published checklists.
steps: Review the official checklist and the relevant building category.
Use the official owner and professional registration routes as applicable.
Track the application through the portal and retain the issued documents.
conditions: Check that MCD is the responsible sanctioning authority for the property. Required NOCs, professional involvement and checks depend on the proposal.

records.department: Jeevan Pramaan - Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
records.coverage: India - digital life certificates for government pensioners using the service
records.description: Generate or access a digital life certificate through the official Jeevan Pramaan service or its centres. This supports pension life certification; it does not apply for a new pension.
records.offlineOption: Jeevan Pramaan centres listed on the official website
conditions: Confirm your Pension Disbursing Agency and pension details when using the service.
records.serviceScope: Digital life certificates for participating government pensioners; not a new pension application
